messages:
sec-bot: [ALERT] SSO anomaly: 3 accounts triggering rapid geo-hops + high MFA push volume within 40m. Accounts: alice@redwood.com, infra-ops@redwood.com, svc-reporting@redwood.com. Pushes: 62 in 22m. Possible MFA fatigue / automated push attempts. Link: https://redwood.incidents/evt/zz9abc
elaine: ack, looking. @raj can you pull the raw auth assertions + device fingerprints for infra-ops and svc-reporting?
raj: running `redwood audit query --event auth --user infra-ops@redwood.com --since 60m --format json` now. quick peek: auths from EU -> US -> APAC in <30m, two user-agent clusters (Firefox/Windows, curl/unknown). IPs appear to rotate via known proxy ranges.
marta: I see session-revoke events for alice at ~1768751200 triggered by an automated protection job. did we run any org-wide revokes? :thinking: 
ops-oncall: I ran targeted revokes for the three accounts ~5m ago: `redwood auth revoke --user alice@redwood.com --all-sessions` etc. did not revoke org-wide. left service accounts alone until we confirm. :white_check_mark: 
elaine: containment plan (short): 1) targeted session revokes for affected accounts (done), 2) rotate any exposed service keys, 3) block flagged IPs at edge, 4) throttle MFA pushes to mitigate fatigue, 5) collect SAML assertions for replay detection.
raj: confirmed revokes done. rotated keys for svc-reporting: `redwood keys rotate --id svc-reporting-key` and kicked CI that depends on it. KMS rotate request submitted: `kms rotate-key --key-id arn:rw:kms:auth-rot` (job queued).
marta: KMS audit shows rotate request at 1768751405 by ops-oncall, rotation job status: pending -> in-progress. logging shows korrelation id `kms-op-1768`.
sec-bot: exported SAML assertion blobs referenced in alert to secure bucket s3://redwood-sec/sso/replay/176875 for analysis. assertion IDs: AS-2391, AS-2392, AS-2393.
elaine: can someone grep for those assertion IDs across the last 24h? prioritize finding replays and assertion reuse.
raj: `redwood logs export --filter "assertion_id:(AS-2391 OR AS-2392 OR AS-2393)" --since 24h --out /tmp/sso-replay-176875` returned 12 matches, 3 unique assertion ids used against the 3 accounts. timestamps clustered within the 22m window.
jonah: threat-intel lookup: 2 of the source IPs are flagged for residential proxy/VPN churn. i've pushed them to WAF blocklist (policy id waf-auth-rapid-block).
marta: comms draft for affected users & CS: "We detected suspicious SSO activity targeting your account; sessions have been revoked and you may have received multiple MFA prompts. We are investigating and will provide an update. If you received unexpected prompts, please do not approve them and contact security." Want sign-off before send.
elaine: send the draft, include short FAQ about not approving unexpected MFA and how to verify sessions in Account > Security. also ask impacted teams if any automated jobs broke due to key rotation.
raj: opened SEC-2026-443 tracking ticket with owners and initial logs attached. Actions: rate-limit auth-push frequency (owner: raj), KMS operation alerts (owner: marta), RBAC audit for service-account exposures (owner: elaine), customer comms (owner: jonah). ETA: 48h for mitigations, 7d for RBAC follow-up.
ops-oncall: monitoring for any repeat signals. set alert rule to escalate at 5 distinct geo zones within 60m for same user.
jonah: preliminary verdict: contained, no signs of post-auth data exfil or lateral access. no password changes observed. will start incident doc with timeline + collected assertion artifacts.
marta: follow-ups: 1) add assertion replay detector to pipeline, 2) add KMS rotate alert to pager, 3) harden service-account scopes to least-privilege.
elaine: marking incident as contained for now. postmortem draft to include timeline, root cause hypotheses (proxy-driven push-farm + MFA fatigue), mitigations applied, and long-term controls. good work everyone. :team-parrot:
